student_actor_contract.belief_input: Only raw local six ranges and own previous requested commands; no poses/IDs/evaluator inputs
student_actor_contract.belief_confidence: Computed posterior concentration, not sensor validity or actual detection/visibility

protocol.sampling: Unmodified Environment circle/random central-square sampler,128 frozen fresh unique seeds, disjoint from earlier circle data and known development/final-heldout worlds. No success filtering or near-goal starts.
protocol.information_boundary: Only the student GRU executes actions. It sees local9 plus its own three local-history belief features and task4. The teacher receives only actual local9/history/calibration and supplies labels. No true poses/IDs/counts/hit classes/targets/contact flags enter either controller. Teacher diagnostic state remains separate.
protocol.selection: Data collection, not a policy-success gate. Keep all128 worlds and every failed/contact state. Require schema/local-feature/command replay before any separately planned fresh imitation. No automatic RL/default promotion.

scope: Unassisted current-student trajectories with local teacher labels and actual student belief inputs. Schema validation only; full physical/command/belief replay required before a fresh learner. No policy acceptance, automatic RL, final-heldout or hardware claim.
